name: Tile cut
description: A picture cut into recursive tiles that slide under the pointer, re-cut on click and merge back into one image as the page scrolls.

label.default: A rainy avenue under a red FORM CITY sign, a still being relit in FormVis with two light handles and their guide line, cut into layers that join back into a single image as you scroll.

copyMouse.default: A still being relit in FormVis, cut into layers and stacked. Click a layer to re-cut it, or move across the pile to slide them apart.

copyTouch.default: A still being relit in FormVis, cut into layers and stacked. Drag a finger across the pile to slide them apart, and tap a layer to re-cut it.

copyDone.default: The cuts are used up. Load a new set to re-cut the pile, or scroll to merge every layer back down.

copyFail.default: The image could not be loaded here. Reload the page to try again.

propDocs.image: The still that is cut. The tiles assume the proportions 1481 by 1400.
propDocs.cuts: Starting number of cuts. The section node marked data-vt-count shows what is left.
propDocs.copyMouse: Written into the node marked data-vt-copy. The component also drives the nodes marked data-vt-count, data-vt-recut, data-vt-back, data-vt-sc and data-vt-fin that sit beside it in the stage.

fallback: If the picture fails the copy line says so and the tiles stay empty. With reduced motion the picture is drawn already merged into one image and no tile moves.
